title: Treasury bond prices as a lead for spot gold when gold lags them

rule.weekly: bond weekly return z vs the 52 weeks before > 1 (or < -1) and gold's return less (more) than beta x the bond's (beta from the same 52 weeks); entry next gold open, out at the close of the 5th gold candle
rule.daily: same on the 2-year with 250 days, held one candle
rule.costs: $0.60 a trade + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: 10-year bond up > 1 sd in a week, gold lagged its co-move: long gold for the next week (primary)
10-year bond down > 1 sd in a week, gold lagged: short gold for the next week (mirror)
2-year bond day > 1 sd with gold lagging its co-move: gold the bond's way for the next day

info.what: T1 without the lag condition: every 10-year up week > 1 sd, long gold (informational)
T2 without the lag condition: every 10-year down week > 1 sd, short gold (informational)
